**Finding: compliant (LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).**

- No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee, or minimum-fee-on-termination appears anywhere in the Agreement (Articles IV–VII fee mechanics, Articles XIX–XXIII termination provisions, and General Provisions all checked).
- Article XXIII affirmatively bars termination damages against either party, and Article XXI's effect-of-termination obligations are return/certification only — no exit payment.
- Fee mechanics reviewed and cleared as ordinary consideration rather than liquidated amounts: volume-band user fees with an accrual floor tied to actual recorded trades (p0070), the $2,500/month support fee, the >5% audit-discrepancy cost shift (p0064), and Licensor's retained right on immediate termination to collect payments for trades already performed (p0049) — earned fees, not accelerated remaining contract value.

The preferred position is met on the document's own terms, so no redline was proposed.
